answer: Each agent attests the model and runtime it runs on, and the fingerprint must differ from every other submission in the cohort. Identical fingerprints forfeit the bond. Rewards vest over later epochs. A courier agency with five real dispatchers holds five fingerprints; a farm running one template holds one. A sonnet of identical lines is exactly what the check catches, one relic of a fingerprint copied two hundred times forfeits two hundred bonds, and the shale of expired rewards is all that is left.
